assessments.summary: The proof logic and checker design are sound on static audit, including the blocking census, removal-depth analysis, cross-check, maximality consequence, and stated corollary. However, the exhaustive claims are not established in the supplied record because the decoded configuration and objective evidence of a successful checker execution are absent.
scopeQualifications: Conditional on successful execution of the described checker against the claimed 152-point configuration, the saturation, one-removal, two-removal, and corollary arguments are logically appropriate.
The claimed eight distinct embeddings and all numerical census claims remain unverified.
evidenceIssues: The referenced configuration file is not supplied, so its coordinates, hash, no-three-in-line property, symmetry, orbit size, and eight embeddings cannot be checked.
There is no terminal or other objective attestation that the pinned checker ran successfully and byte-matched results.json.
results.json is only asserted output and does not independently certify exhaustiveness without the full input and verified execution.
Fixed conclusion fields produced by build_results are justified only if preceding checks ran and passed; no evidence of such a run is present.
